# git: alias: refactor alias.refresh, alias.shake, and alias.untag

Part of [#355](DOT-354.md): move [git_refresh](../../bin/git_refresh), [git_shake](../../bin/git_shake) and [git_untag](../../bin/git_untag) into `bin/lib/git/sync.bash` as functions and register them as `!@ git-refresh`, `!@ git-shake`, `!@ git-untag` (the note says `git-please` for the third, a slip). Action items to plan alongside: fork refresh [#146](DOT-145.md), the pull hook strategy [#239](DOT-238.md), `shake` with a custom main branch [#123](DOT-122.md), `shake all` errors [#160](DOT-159.md).

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/359#issuecomment-5711700698
Code vs intent: `refresh`, `shake`, `untag` are registered only by `bin/legacy/git`, which nothing runs; on any machine configured after 2022 these aliases do not exist and only the `git_*` script names work. The same holds for `mirror`, `url`, `root`, `stats`, `delta`, `whoami`, `branches`, `aliases`, `configure`, `flow`, `attach`. Either `git_config` should re-register them or the scripts should be treated as retired.
